title: Kade Waxed Parka
description: A long parka in 8oz waxed cotton, cut straight and finished with a storm placket. The wax dulls and marks with wear; that is the point of it.

specs.care: Sponge clean. Rewax once a year. Never machine wash.

title: Noord Wool Overcoat
description: Single-breasted, unstructured through the shoulder, in a dense Italian wool melton. Wears over a jacket without pulling across the back.

specs.care: Dry clean only. Brush after wear.

title: Veer Shell Jacket
description: A two-layer recycled nylon shell with taped seams and a concealed hood. Packs into its own chest pocket.

specs.care: Machine wash 30°. Tumble dry low to reactivate the DWR.

title: Dijk Chore Jacket
description: Three patch pockets, a flat collar, and nothing else. Garment-dyed cotton twill that softens after a week.

specs.care: Machine wash 30°. Line dry. Expect it to fade.

title: Spui Quilted Liner
description: A thin quilted layer built to go under the parka or on its own in October. Recycled wadding, no bulk at the shoulder.

specs.material: Recycled polyamide shell, recycled polyester wadding
specs.care: Machine wash 30°. Do not iron.

title: IJ Trench
description: The trench stripped of its epaulettes, storm flap and D-rings. What is left is a coat, a belt and a good cotton gabardine.

specs.care: Dry clean only.

title: Vecht Field Jacket
description: Four pockets, a drawcord waist, and a collar that stands without help. Cut wide enough for a knit underneath.

specs.care: Machine wash 30°. Line dry.

title: Sluis Anorak
description: Half-zip, one kangaroo pocket, a hood that closes down to a slot. Made for a wet ride home.

specs.care: Machine wash 30°. Do not tumble dry.

title: Havik Bomber
description: A wool-blend bomber with knitted rib at the cuff and hem. Short in the body, wide in the sleeve.

specs.material: 62% wool, 38% polyamide, rib trim in merino
specs.care: Dry clean only.

title: Wal Overshirt
description: Heavy enough to be a jacket, soft enough to be a shirt. Two chest pockets, corozo buttons.

specs.care: Machine wash 30°. Warm iron.

title: Doorn Rain Coat
description: A long, unlined rain coat with sealed seams and vents under the arm. Last of the previous colour.

specs.care: Machine wash 30°. Do not iron. Do not dry clean.

title: Merino Crew
description: The plain crew, knitted in extrafine merino at a gauge that holds its shape. Wears alone or under everything else here.

specs.care: Hand wash cold. Dry flat. Do not wring.

title: Kern Cable Knit
description: A five-gauge cable in undyed lambswool. Heavy in the hand, and it will grow half a size with wear.

specs.care: Hand wash cold. Dry flat.

title: Bree Half-Zip
description: A long zip through a stand collar, in a milled merino that sits flat. Closed it is a rollneck; open it is not.

specs.care: Hand wash cold. Dry flat.

title: Loof Mock Neck
description: A short stand collar instead of a fold. Fine merino, ribbed at the cuff and hem, nothing at the shoulder.

specs.care: Hand wash cold. Dry flat.

title: Stil Fine-Gauge Crew
description: Twelve-gauge cotton, knitted thin enough to wear indoors all year. The neck is banded, not rolled.

specs.care: Machine wash 30° on wool cycle. Dry flat.

title: Wold Chunky Rollneck
description: Three-gauge virgin wool with a collar deep enough to fold twice. Warm past the point of needing a coat.

specs.care: Hand wash cold. Dry flat. Store folded.

title: Vlas Linen Knit
description: An open-gauge linen crew for the four weeks a year it is warm here. Creases immediately and looks better for it.

specs.care: Machine wash 30°. Dry flat. Do not bleach.

title: Kaap Cardigan
description: A long cardigan in brushed lambswool with horn buttons and deep patch pockets. Cut to be worn open.

specs.care: Hand wash cold. Dry flat.

title: Nes Knit Polo
description: Three buttons, a soft collar, and a straight hem meant to be worn out. Knitted in a dry-handling cotton.

specs.care: Machine wash 30° on wool cycle. Dry flat.

title: Zand Waffle Knit
description: A waffle-structure crew in cotton and wool. Textured enough to carry a plain outfit on its own.

specs.care: Hand wash cold. Dry flat.

title: Grid Rib Scarf
description: Two metres of ribbed merino, wide enough to double. Finished by hand at both ends.

specs.care: Hand wash cold. Dry flat.

title: Merino Beanie
description: A fine-rib watch cap with a single fold. No badge, no label on the outside.

specs.care: Hand wash cold. Dry flat.

title: Bouclé Crew
description: A looped bouclé yarn in an otherwise plain crew. All of the texture is in the thread.

specs.care: Hand wash cold. Dry flat.

title: Kraal Leather Jacket
description: Full-grain calfskin, unlined through the body, with a plain zip and no hardware beyond it. It will crease at the elbow within a month and keep those creases.

specs.care: Wipe with a dry cloth. Condition yearly. Never machine wash.

title: Kade Leather Bomber
description: A soft lambskin bomber with merino rib at the collar, cuff and hem. Heavier than it looks on the hanger.

specs.care: Wipe with a dry cloth. Condition yearly.

title: Veld Leather Tote
description: One compartment, two handles, a laptop sleeve inside. Cut from a single hide so the grain runs continuously.

specs.care: Wipe with a dry cloth. Condition twice a year.

title: Haven Weekend Holdall
description: A 40-litre holdall with a detachable strap and solid brass hardware, aged dark. Sized for the cabin.

specs.material: Full-grain vegetable-tanned leather, cotton canvas lining
specs.care: Wipe with a dry cloth. Condition twice a year.

title: Riem Belt
description: Thirty millimetres of bridle leather with a brushed steel buckle. Five holes, no keeper logo.

specs.care: Wipe with a dry cloth. Condition yearly.

title: Kaart Card Holder
description: Four slots, one centre pocket, cut and folded from a single piece. Flat enough for a front pocket.

specs.care: Wipe with a dry cloth.

title: Winter Leather Gloves
description: Hairsheep leather over a cashmere lining, with three points of hand stitching across the back.

specs.care: Wipe with a dry cloth. Do not soak.

title: Damrak Derby
description: A plain derby on a blake-stitched leather sole, with a rounded last that is neither square nor sharp. Resoleable.

specs.material: Full-grain box calf upper, leather sole
specs.care: Brush after wear. Use trees. Resole when the sole thins.
